See LICENSE in the project root. */ package com.chillingout9.nextstar; import lombok.Getter; import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor; /** * Teleport methods a player can own. Each value (except {@link #NONE}) maps to a * toggle in {@link NextStarConfig}; only unlocked methods are considered when scoring * the easiest teleport for a region in {@link TeleportTable}. *

* {@link #NONE} marks an always-available fallback option and has no config toggle. */ @Getter @RequiredArgsConstructor public enum TeleportUnlock { NONE("(always available)"), STANDARD_SPELLBOOK("Standard spellbook teleports"), AMULET_OF_GLORY("Amulet of glory"), RING_OF_DUELING("Ring of dueling"), RING_OF_WEALTH("Ring of wealth"), GAMES_NECKLACE("Games necklace"), SKILLS_NECKLACE("Skills necklace"), COMBAT_BRACELET("Combat bracelet"), DIGSITE_PENDANT("Digsite pendant"), XERICS_TALISMAN("Xeric's talisman"), FAIRY_RINGS("Fairy rings"), SPIRIT_TREE("Spirit tree"), MINING_CAPE("Mining cape"), CRAFTING_CAPE("Crafting cape"), KOUREND_TELEPORT("Kourend teleport (Memoirs / Book of the Dead)"), VARLAMORE_TELEPORT("Varlamore teleport"), CRYSTAL_TELEPORT("Crystal teleport (Lletya / Prifddinas)"), LUNAR_TELEPORT("Lunar / Moonclan teleport (Lunar Isle)"); private final String label; }
